flagship_project.name: Project VaultZero: Zero-Knowledge Sovereign High-Yield Private Neo-Banking Core & Real-Time Trust Ledger
flagship_project.pillar: Zero-Knowledge Confidential Computing & Autonomous Private Wealth Engine
flagship_project.strategic_thesis: CRED commands the top 1% affluent Indian consumers with over $100B in annual credit card spend. VaultZero transforms CRED into a zero-knowledge confidential banking core, executing automated high-yield treasury management, instant multi-card liquidity sweeps, and provable private underwriting.
flagship_project.tech_stack: Rust (Zero-Knowledge ZK-SNARK Prover), Go (Account Core), PostgreSQL with Citus Sharding, Redis Cluster, Apache Iceberg (Data Lakehouse), AWS Nitro Enclaves / Confidential Virtual Machines
flagship_project.kpis: 100% confidential credit score & net-worth computation with zero raw data exposure; $5B+ automated treasury allocation; sub-10ms bill settlement verification.
